[!symlink] skip 'fake GOROOT needs symlinks'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOWORK=off
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# A toolchain Go source that is also an embed asset must copy once with
# the overlay replacement bytes: the source pass and the embed pass
# agree instead of aborting on a rewrite conflict. The test installs
# fixture packages in a private toolchain root inside $WORK and selects
# it with GOROOT. Nothing is written into the real GOROOT.
go run mkgoroot.go $TESTGO_GOROOT $WORK/fakegoroot dep
go run mkovl.go $WORK/fakegoroot $WORK/ovl
env GOROOT=$WORK/fakegoroot

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^original$'

logos build -overlay=$WORK/ovl/overlay.json --emit-go=out .
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestembed/version.go
grep '"patched"' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestembed/version.go
! grep '"original"' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestembed/version.go

env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd out
go build -mod=readonly ./...
go run .
stdout '^patched$'

# A replacement that needs import rewriting still aborts: the embed pass
# cannot copy bytes the source pass rewrote, so the genuine rewrite
# conflict is kept.
cd ..
env GOROOT=$WORK/fakegoroot
! logos build -overlay=$WORK/ovl/overlay2.json --emit-go=out2 .
stderr 'cannot be emitted both as rewritten Go and as a verbatim asset'

-- mkgoroot.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"
)

func must(err error, what string) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkgoroot: %s: %v\n", what, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func link(oldname, newname string) {
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(newname), 0777), "mkdir "+filepath.Dir(newname))
	must(os.Symlink(oldname, newname), "symlink "+newname)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 4 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: mkgoroot <realGOROOT> <fakeRoot> <fixtures>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	real, fake, fixtures := os.Args[1], os.Args[2], os.Args[3]

	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), 0777), "mkdir fake src/logos")

	ents, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(real, "src"))
	must(err, "read real src")
	for _, e := range ents {
		if e.Name() == "logos" {
			continue
		}
		link(filepath.Join(real, "src", e.Name()), filepath.Join(fake, "src", e.Name()))
	}

	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(filepath.Join(real, "src", "logos"))), "copy support sources")
	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(fixtures)), "install fixture packages")

	// The package index distinguishes .lgo-only standard packages, but
	// bypasses files with recent mtimes. Age only the private copies.
	old := time.Now().Add(-time.Hour)
	must(filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), func(name string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || !d.Type().IsRegular() {
			return err
		}
		return os.Chtimes(name, old, old)
	}), "age copied support and fixture files")

	link(filepath.Join(real, "pkg"), filepath.Join(fake, "pkg"))
	link(filepath.Join(real, "VERSION"), filepath.Join(fake, "VERSION"))
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "go.env")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "go.env"), filepath.Join(fake, "go.env"))
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "lib")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "lib"), filepath.Join(fake, "lib"))
	}
}

-- mkovl.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

func must(err error, what string) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkovl: %s: %v\n", what, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func quote(s string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteByte('"')
	for _, r := range s {
		switch r {
		case '\\', '"':
			b.WriteByte('\\')
			b.WriteRune(r)
		default:
			b.WriteRune(r)
		}
	}
	b.WriteByte('"')
	return b.String()
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: mkovl <fakeGOROOT> <outdir>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	fake, out := os.Args[1], os.Args[2]
	must(os.MkdirAll(out, 0777), "mkdir "+out)
	patched := "package ejecttestembed\n\nconst Version = \"patched\"\n"
	patchedPath := filepath.Join(out, "version.go")
	must(os.WriteFile(patchedPath, []byte(patched), 0666), "write "+patchedPath)
	// Age the replacement like mkgoroot ages the private tree, so the
	// package index sees the effective file instead of bypassing it.
	old := time.Now().Add(-2 * time.Hour)
	must(os.Chtimes(patchedPath, old, old), "chtimes "+patchedPath)
	rewrite := "package ejecttestembed\n\nimport \"logos/rt\"\n\nconst Version = \"patched2\"\n\nvar _ = rt.HashString\n"
	rewritePath := filepath.Join(out, "version_rewrite.go")
	must(os.WriteFile(rewritePath, []byte(rewrite), 0666), "write "+rewritePath)
	must(os.Chtimes(rewritePath, old, old), "chtimes "+rewritePath)
	replaced := filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos", "ejecttestembed", "version.go")
	doc := "{\n\"Replace\": {\n" +
		quote(replaced) + ": " + quote(patchedPath) + "\n}\n}\n"
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "overlay.json"), []byte(doc), 0666), "write overlay.json")
	doc2 := "{\n\"Replace\": {\n" +
		quote(replaced) + ": " + quote(rewritePath) + "\n}\n}\n"
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "overlay2.json"), []byte(doc2), 0666), "write overlay2.json")
}

-- dep/ejecttestembed/version.go --
package ejecttestembed

const Version = "original"

-- dep/ejecttestembed/embed.go --
package ejecttestembed

import _ "embed"

//go:embed version.go
var versionFile string

func Which() string { return Version }

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/embeddep

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/ejecttestembed"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(ejecttestembed.Which())
}
